changelog:
- Added instructions for withdrawing a submission within 1 hour, including usage of the new withdraw CLI command.
- Updated supported upload file types and folders; clarified that file size limits are enforced by the server and errors are explicit.
- Set a maximum of 5 files per submission using --media-key.
- Improved documentation for submission status flows, including AI_AUTO and CREATOR verification.
- Clarified distinctions between --media-key (uploaded files) and --proof-url (external links).
- Minor edits for accuracy, constraints, and to keep guidance up-to-date with the latest OpenAnt CLI behavior.
